scenarios.title: A｜没听懂要求
scenarios.setting: 在“确认工作任务”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“没听懂要求”。

turns.text: For this task, take the latest version, update the first section, and then send it to Morgan before the client meeting.

turns.prompt: 你想请同事再说明一次工作要求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sorry, could you go over that one more time?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, could you go over that one more time?
feedback.explanation: “more / extra / another”表示在已有数量上增加，能说明是补充需求。

choices.text: I didn’t quite catch the last part. Could you repeat it?

feedback.naturalExpression: I didn’t quite catch the last part. Could you repeat it?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Just to make sure I understood, which version should I use?

feedback.naturalExpression: Just to make sure I understood, which version should I use?
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。

choices.text: Sorry, could you break that down for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, could you break that down for me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I don’t understand what you said.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, could you go over that one more time?
feedback.explanation: 这句能表达不理解；指出没听懂的具体部分，能让对方有针对性地解释。

turns.text: Sure. Use the latest version, update the first section, then send it to Morgan.

turns.prompt: 你想核实自己对刚才信息的理解，会怎么问？

choices.text: Got it. So I don’t need to change the other sections?

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. So I don’t need to change the other sections?
feedback.explanation: “I don’t need”说明当前不需要这项服务或物品，避免对方继续安排。

choices.text: Okay. Just the first section, right?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Just the first section, right?
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

choices.text: And I should send it directly to Morgan when I’m done?

feedback.naturalExpression: And I should send it directly to Morgan when I’m done?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

scenarios.title: B｜确认具体内容
scenarios.setting: 在“确认工作任务”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“确认具体内容”。

turns.text: Could you make a few changes to the presentation before tomorrow’s meeting?

turns.prompt: 你想表达认同或相似的感受，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. What exactly would you like me to change?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. What exactly would you like me to change?
feedback.explanation: 先询问对方的意愿或偏好，再作安排，让对方参与选择。

choices.text: Which slides should I focus on?

feedback.naturalExpression: Which slides should I focus on?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Are you looking for content changes or mainly visual changes?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are you looking for content changes or mainly visual changes?
feedback.explanation: “looking for”表示正在寻找，区别于强调找到结果的“find”。

choices.text: Is there anything you definitely want me to keep?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything you definitely want me to keep?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: What things should I change exactly?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. What exactly would you like me to change?
feedback.explanation: 这句可以理解；“Which parts should I change?”更明确询问需要修改的部分。

turns.text: Mostly the first five slides. The information is fine, but the layout needs some work.

turns.prompt: 关于「确认工作任务」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: So the content can stay the same, and I should focus on the layout?

feedback.naturalExpression: So the content can stay the same, and I should focus on the layout?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Got it. Do you want me to keep the current style?

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Do you want me to keep the current style?
feedback.explanation: 用于邀请或商量，先确认对方是否愿意，再决定后续安排。

choices.text: Should I also update the charts, or leave those as they are?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I also update the charts, or leave those as they are?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

turns.text: Leave the charts for now. Just focus on the layout.

turns.prompt: 关于「确认工作任务」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Understood. I’ll focus on the first five slides.

feedback.naturalExpression: Understood. I’ll focus on the first five slides.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Got it. I’ll leave the charts as they are.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. I’ll leave the charts as they are.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: C｜确认截止日期
scenarios.setting: 在“确认工作任务”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“确认截止日期”。

turns.text: Can you take care of this as well?

turns.prompt: 你想了解时间安排或需要等多久，会怎么问？

choices.text: Sure. When do you need it by?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. When do you need it by?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: What’s the deadline for this?

feedback.naturalExpression: What’s the deadline for this?
feedback.explanation: “deadline”指截止期限，指最晚需要完成的时间。

choices.text: Would you need this today, or is tomorrow okay?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would you need this today, or is tomorrow okay?
feedback.explanation: 把两种可能列出来请对方确认，适合核对自己拿不准的细节。

choices.text: How urgent is this?

feedback.naturalExpression: How urgent is this?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: When should I finish this until?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. When do you need it by?
feedback.explanation: 截止时间用“by”，持续到某时才用“until”；问“When do you need it by?”更简洁。

turns.text: Ideally, I’d like to have it by three tomorrow afternoon.

turns.prompt: 关于「确认工作任务」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, I’ll have it ready by three tomorrow.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ll have it ready by three tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Got it. Is three a hard deadline?

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Is three a hard deadline?
feedback.explanation: “deadline”指截止期限，指最晚需要完成的时间。

choices.text: Would it be okay if I sent it a little earlier for you to review?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be okay if I sent it a little earlier for you to review?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: I have another task due tomorrow morning. Is three still okay?

feedback.naturalExpression: I have another task due tomorrow morning. Is three still okay?
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

turns.text: Three is fine. If you can send it earlier, even better.

turns.prompt: 关于「确认工作任务」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sounds good. I’ll aim to send it before lunch.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sounds good. I’ll aim to send it before lunch.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Great. I’ll let you know if anything affects the timing.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll let you know if anything affects the timing.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
